parser_findings: PromptSource::GeminiTakeout and PromptSource::MarkdownJournal in crates/prompt-parsers/src/lib.rs (lines 18-19) are dead enum variants with zero parsing logic.

parse_exported_conversations_json (lines 264-355) only parses Claude ('chat_messages') and ChatGPT ('mapping') arrays, and fails to populate summary.earliest_date, summary.latest_date, or summary.category_counts.
ChatGPT create_time is a Unix epoch float (e.g. 1729000000.0), so extract_hour() (which looks for ISO 'T(\d{2}):\d{2}') always returns None for ChatGPT exports.
persistence_findings: persist_prompts_to_sqlite in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/main.rs (line 269) executes 'DELETE FROM prompts' unconditionally and hardcodes source = 'antigravity' (line 278).

In apps/desktop/src/App.tsx (lines 155-161), handleFileUpload invokes import_exported_json and immediately calls runScan(), which calls scan_local_vault -> persist_prompts_to_sqlite -> DELETE FROM prompts, wiping all newly imported Claude/ChatGPT prompts and replacing the dashboard exclusively with local Antigravity brain files.
scan_local_vault automatically scans %USERPROFILE%/.gemini/antigravity/brain on app launch without user opt-in and provides no Reset/Clear Vault capability.
